name: microsoft_advertising-mcp
description: Microsoft Advertising (Bing Ads) (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, update_budget, pause_resu

platform_mcp_microsoft_advertising_clien.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MICROSOFT_ADVERTISING_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_microsoft_advertising_clien.description: Application (client) id of the Microsoft Entra app registration used for the Microsoft Advertising consent.

platform_mcp_microsoft_advertising_clien.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MICROSOFT_ADVERTISING_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_microsoft_advertising_clien.description: The app's client secret; required for web apps, omit for native/public clients.

platform_mcp_microsoft_advertising_refre.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MICROSOFT_ADVERTISING_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_microsoft_advertising_refre.description: Refresh token from the authorization-code flow with scope https://ads.microsoft.com/msads.manage offline_access; the runtime mints access tokens from it at https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/oauth2/v2.0/token.

platform_mcp_microsoft_advertising_devel.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MICROSOFT_ADVERTISING_DEVELOPER_TOKEN
platform_mcp_microsoft_advertising_devel.description: Microsoft Advertising developer token (Developer Portal > Account), sent as the DeveloperToken header.

platform_mcp_microsoft_advertising_custo.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MICROSOFT_ADVERTISING_CUSTOMER_ID
platform_mcp_microsoft_advertising_custo.description: Manager account (customer) id sent as the CustomerId header; list_accounts searches this customer's accounts.

platform_mcp_microsoft_advertising_accou.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MICROSOFT_ADVERTISING_ACCOUNT_ID
platform_mcp_microsoft_advertising_accou.description: Ad account id sent as the CustomerAccountId header; it must equal the AccountId in campaign calls, so pass the same id as list_campaigns' account_id.

platform_mcp_microsoft_advertising_env.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MICROSOFT_ADVERTISING_ENV
platform_mcp_microsoft_advertising_env.description: Vendor environment (default production): sandbox = https://campaign.api.sandbox.bingads.microsoft.com. Credentials are the environment's own; see adapter.environments in the catalog entry.

platform_mcp_microsoft_advertising_base_.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MICROSOFT_ADVERTISING_BASE_URL
platform_mcp_microsoft_advertising_base_.description: Optional https base URL override (a mock or a private gateway); replaces the selected environment's base_url. Never echoed in errors.

tools.name: me
tools.description: REST POST /CustomerManagement/v13/Accounts/Search with the predicate AccountId Equals <configured account_id>: {Accounts: [AdvertiserAccount]} describes the connected ad account (Id, Name, Number, CurrencyCode, AccountLifeCycleStatus, ParentCustomerId).

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: REST POST /CustomerManagement/v13/Accounts/Search with the predicate CustomerId Equals <configured customer_id> and PageInfo {Index: 0, Size: 100} (list_accounts takes no paging arguments, so the first 100 accounts are returned).

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: REST POST /CampaignManagement/v13/Campaigns/QueryByAccountId {AccountId}. account_id must equal the configured account_id (sent as CustomerAccountId). Without CampaignType only Search campaigns are returned; the call is unpaged and `status`/`page` are not sent. `budget` is DailyBudget in the account currency (BudgetType in raw).

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: REST PUT /CampaignManagement/v13/Campaigns {AccountId (config), Campaigns: [{Id, DailyBudget}]}: only the sent elements change. Campaigns using a shared budget must be changed on the budget instead. The service answers 200 with per-item failures in PartialErrors: the update succeeded only when partial_errors is empty. `currency` is ignored (account currency).

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: REST PUT /CampaignManagement/v13/Campaigns {AccountId (config), Campaigns: [{Id, Status: Paused|Active}]}; per-item failures come back in PartialErrors (the change applied only when partial_errors is empty).
